apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.description: Create scenes, capture games and devices, mix audio, record local proof, and stream to supported services.
apps.notes: Installs the OBS Project Flathub build. Capture cards and hardware encoders still require real-hardware testing.

apps.name: Chatterino
apps.description: Keep stream chat in a dedicated, customizable desktop window while running or moderating.
apps.notes: Installs the Chatterino package published on Flathub.

apps.name: Bottles
apps.summary: Run selected Windows applications in managed environments.
apps.description: Create isolated Wine environments for Windows tools that do not yet have a native Linux build.
apps.notes: Installing Bottles does not certify every Windows timer or component. G-OS will validate those combinations individually.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.description: Browse leaderboard sites, stream dashboards, guides, and web-based speedrunning tools.
apps.notes: Google provides a 64-bit Fedora RPM, not an official Flathub package. G-OS must finalize image-level repository, update, and redistribution handling before enabling it.

apps.name: LiveSplit Complete
apps.summary: Classic LiveSplit with a curated G-OS setup.
apps.description: The planned bundle will include the timer plus tested layouts, components, and compatibility settings.
apps.notes: Classic LiveSplit is a Windows application. G-OS plans a managed Bottles/Wine bundle, but every component and autosplitter must be validated before certification.

apps.name: SCU
apps.description: A G-OS project intended to simplify capture and speedrunning workflows.
apps.notes: First-party project. Its Linux build, dependencies, device access, and package format must be reviewed before G Store can enable installation.

apps.name: AutoSplit64
apps.description: A G-OS project for automated timer control in supported speedruns.
apps.notes: First-party project. Linux process access, timer integration, supported targets, and packaging must be validated before release.

apps.name: NSMBW Autosplitter
apps.summary: Automatic splits for New Super Mario Bros. Wii.
apps.description: A first-party G-OS autosplitter planned for the NSMBW speedrunning pack.
apps.notes: The target Dolphin version, Linux process access, timer bridge, and behavior across game regions need certification before one-click installation.

apps.name: Gcord
apps.summary: First-party communication tool for G-OS runners.
apps.description: A G-OS project planned for speedrunning community and session workflows.
apps.notes: First-party project. Runtime, authentication, Linux integration, and packaging details must be reviewed before enabling it.

apps.name: RetroSpy
apps.summary: Display controller inputs from retro consoles and computers.
apps.description: RetroSpy is the next iteration of NintendoSpy and provides Linux downloads for its input-display tools.
apps.notes: Preferred successor to NintendoSpy. G-OS needs a maintained package plus safe serial/udev permissions and real-device testing on its Fedora base.

apps.name: NintendoSpy (Legacy)
apps.description: NintendoSpy displays inputs from supported Nintendo consoles through its viewer and Arduino interface.
apps.notes: The upstream owner says it is not actively developed, and its viewer is a Windows application. RetroSpy is the preferred path; legacy Wine support would require separate testing.
